result.rationale: The migration does `category_id = execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` with no nil check. Sites that never customized `embed_category` (default was '' per config/site_settings.yml, and default settings are typically not persisted) will get an empty result set, so `[0]` is nil and the migration crashes with NoMethodError, aborting the deploy.
